{u}{b}{c_important}Whisper Caches{/c}{/b}{/u} sometimes contain {c_important}Corrupted Roots{/c}.

Plant {c_important}Corrupted Roots{/c} to grow an {c_important}Exposed Root{/c}. These will attract nearby enemies, and have a chance to grow larger and summon more fearsome enemies.

The regions of Sanctuary each bear different fruit.

{icon:Marker_Season_Green_font,2.5}At Rank {c_number}8{/c} with the {c_important}Splinter of Terror{/c}, {c_important}Corrupted Roots{/c} appear more often in {u}{b}{c_important}Whisper Caches{/c}{/b}{/u}.
